skill.summary: Supply chain security for agent skills. Pre-install inspection, post-install scanning, obfuscation detection, and known-bad signature matching. Verify skills are safe before they touch your workspace. Free alert layer — upgrade to openclaw-sentinel-pro for quarantine, blocking, and community threat feeds.
